name: Front RGB camera
description_from_assessment: Forward-facing 1080p RGB camera, 120° field of view, mounted at 1.1 m. Not safety-rated: used for navigation assistance (person detection for early slowdown) and the teleoperation video. Connected only to the main computer, not to the safety PLC (whose inputs are the safety LiDAR, bumper, cliff sensors and e-stops).

name: 2D safety LiDAR
description_from_assessment: Safety-rated 2D laser scanner (type 3, PL d) at 18 cm height with a 275° field. Speed-dependent protective and warning fields, evaluated by the safety PLC.

name: Ultrasonic sensor array
description_from_assessment: Eight ultrasonic sensors around the base for low and glass obstacles that the LiDAR plane misses. Not safety-rated: the main computer slows the robot on them. Connected only to the main computer, not to the safety PLC (whose inputs are the safety LiDAR, bumper, cliff sensors and e-stops).

name: Bumper switch
description_from_assessment: Full-perimeter pressure-sensitive bumper, dual-channel to the safety PLC. Contact triggers safe torque off and the brakes.

name: Cliff sensors
description_from_assessment: Four downward time-of-flight sensors at the corners detect drops over 3 cm (stairs, mezzanine edge, open floor hatches). Dual-channel to the safety PLC.

name: Drive motors
description_from_assessment: Two 24 V brushless hub motors with dual encoders. Speed monitored by the safety PLC; safe torque off (STO) on both drives.

name: Electromagnetic brakes
description_from_assessment: Spring-applied, power-off brakes on both drive wheels, with a manual release lever for pushing the robot when it is switched off.

name: Wheels and castors
description_from_assessment: Two 250 mm non-marking drive wheels and two swivel castors.

name: Brush deck
description_from_assessment: Two counter-rotating 33 cm disc brushes at 200 rpm under a rubber splash skirt. Brush motors stop with the drive and when the deck is lifted.

name: Squeegee and vacuum
description_from_assessment: Rear curved squeegee with a vacuum motor recovering dirty water into the 40 L recovery tank.

name: Solution tank
description_from_assessment: 40 L solution tank with a waist-height fill port and a closed-loop coupling for pre-diluted detergent cartridges.

name: Chemical dosing pump
description_from_assessment: Peristaltic pump dosing detergent at 0.5–2 % into the brush deck feed; maximum flow limited in software.

name: Li-ion battery pack
description_from_assessment: 25.2 V, 150 Ah lithium-ion pack with NMC cells in a vented steel enclosure; UN 38.3 and IEC 62133-2 certified. Removed by a technician with a service plug. A change of cell chemistry is made in this pack (same enclosure, connector and mounting) and changes the BMS charge and thermal limits.

name: Battery management system
description_from_assessment: Monitors cell voltages and temperatures, balances the cells and opens the pack contactor on over-voltage, over-current or over-temperature (SF-07). Configured for the pack's NMC chemistry: CC-CV to 4.2 V per cell, 55 °C cut-off. Opens the contactor in service mode.

name: Charger contacts
description_from_assessment: Two spring-loaded contacts under the rear bumper that mate with the docking station's charging plates.

name: Main computer
description_from_assessment: Navigation and cleaning computer: localisation, path planning, person detection and fleet connection. Not safety-rated. Software 4.2.1.

name: Safety PLC
description_from_assessment: Dual-channel safety controller that runs every safety function of the robot. Its safety-rated inputs are the safety LiDAR, bumper, cliff sensors and e-stops; it monitors speed and commands the protective stops (STO and brakes) of every actuator: the drive and the brushes. Firmware 2.3.0. Any new actuator (motor, arm or tool) must be added to its safety program and the program validated again; a sensor only when it becomes one of the safety-rated inputs listed here.

name: E-stop buttons
description_from_assessment: Two red mushroom-head buttons, front and rear, at 0.9 m height.

name: Safety relay
description_from_assessment: Dual-channel safety relay with monitored reset in the e-stop chain; cuts power to every motor (drive and brushes). Any new motor or actuator must be wired into the e-stop chain.

name: Wireless link
description_from_assessment: LTE and hospital Wi-Fi link to the remote operations centre, with a heartbeat watchdog for teleoperation. Carries the teleoperation video stream whatever camera or sensor feeds it, so a change of camera or sensor does not change the link.

name: Touchscreen
description_from_assessment: 10-inch touchscreen at the rear for starting routes, resetting stops and status. Setup functions are PIN-protected.

name: Warning light
description_from_assessment: Blue LED beacon and projected floor light, on whenever the robot moves or stands in a corridor.

name: Speaker
description_from_assessment: Spoken warnings and chimes at 60–75 dB(A), depending on the time of day.

name: Charging plates
description_from_assessment: Two charging plates at 12 cm height, energised only after the docked robot's handshake.

name: Charger unit
description_from_assessment: Mains-powered 30 A charger with earth-fault protection; charges as the BMS requests.
